Corporate-Card Startup Ramp Raising Funds at $70 Billion Valuation

The financing round is the fast-growing company’s third fundraise in a year

By

Corporate-card and expense-management startup Ramp is in early discussions with investors to raise $1 billion or more at a valuation of more than $70 billion as it continues to fundraise at a furious pace, according to people familiar with the matter.

The deal would mark the third funding round in a year for Ramp, a credit-card company that also offers AI-powered business financial-management tools. Its valuation has more than doubled over that period.
